subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Multiplexers: Data Selectors
description: A fast breakdown of Multiplexers: Data Selectors for builders.

hook.text: A multiplexer picks one of many inputs and sends it to the output. A digital switch.

buildup.text: Select lines choose which input to pass through. Two select lines handle four inputs.

discovery.text: Any Boolean function can be implemented with a large enough multiplexer — it's universal.

twist.text: Demultiplexers do the reverse — route one input to one of many outputs.

climax.text: Network routers, memory buses, and display controllers all use multiplexing.

punchline.text: Many inputs, one output — the multiplexer picks the winner.

quiz.question: How many select lines does a 4-to-1 multiplexer need?
